answer_1.quote: We consider the problem of evaluating long-form text generation for specific discourse properties.

answer_2.quote: We propose a statistical tool, model criticism in latent space, which projects text to a latent space based on an assumptive generative process, and compares the implied latent distribution.

answer_4.quote: Each human annotator first labels the section title of each section (after a training phase where they labeled and received feedback on real data), and then labels whether the organization of the section titles makes sense (Persing et al., 2010).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators label section types and judge coherence based on section organization.
